user.title: Learn your Home Assistant actions
user.description: Observe actions you perform in Home Assistant and learn recurring times and short sequences automatically. Suggestions appear as ordinary dashboard entities and work with Assist. Use Always apply to allow an exact action to repeat automatically. No fields are needed.

control.title: What should be controlled?
control.description: Pick the entity that should be switched on and off for you.

pattern.title: What should it learn from?
pattern.description: Pick one or more entities that show when something is in use: a power sensor, the device itself, a media player, a motion sensor … There is nothing else to set up; what counts as active is learned from the data.

error.no_entities: Pick at least one entity to learn from.

abort.already_configured: This entity is already controlled by a pattern.

data.guard_grace_minutes: Switch off after being unused for

data_description.learn_entities: The controlled entity counts as in use while any of these is active. For numeric sensors, what counts as active is worked out from the data.
data_description.lead_minutes: Minutes before the learned start of use.
data_description.off_delay_minutes: Minutes after the learned end of use.
data_description.guard_grace_minutes: The entity is never switched off while in use. Once it has been unused for this long, a postponed switch-off happens.
data_description.window_days: Older data is forgotten and recent days count more, so the model follows slow changes on its own.
data_description.min_days: Nothing is predicted before this many complete days were observed. It is also how many days are needed to tell weekdays apart.
data_description.min_confidence: A period counts as a habit when the model is at least this sure there is use.

recommendations.title: Action recommendations
recommendations.description: There are no learning settings to configure. Use Apply, Dismiss, Always apply and Automatic actions on the device page or a dashboard. Add ML Automation again to create a separate switching pattern.

error.no_entities: Pick at least one entity to learn from.

list_suggestions.name: List action suggestions
list_suggestions.description: Return the currently active action suggestions and their IDs.

suggestion_id.name: Suggestion ID
suggestion_id.description: The exact ID returned by the suggestion sensor or List action suggestions.

authorize.name: Always apply
authorize.description: Also allow this exact action and its parameters to run automatically in the future.

dismiss_action_suggestion.name: Dismiss action suggestion
dismiss_action_suggestion.description: Dismiss this occurrence. Repeated dismissals suppress the learned rule.

suggestion_id.name: Suggestion ID
suggestion_id.description: The exact ID of the suggestion to dismiss.

revoke_action_autonomy.name: Revoke automatic action
revoke_action_autonomy.description: Return an authorized action to suggestions only.

action_key.name: Action key
action_key.description: The key listed under authorized_actions on the action learning status sensor.

schedule_reason.message: Performed around this time on {days} days.

suggestion_expired.message: This suggestion has expired or was already handled.

action_unavailable.message: The suggested action or its target is unavailable.

assist_no_suggestion.message: I have no suggestion right now.

assist_failed.message: That suggestion expired or could not be applied.
